header.kid: Non-empty Atom signing-key id. Verification rejects missing, unknown, and retired key ids.

claims.iss: Exact configured issuer string; required and validated.
claims.aud: Exact configured audience string; required and validated.
claims.sub: Entity UUID in canonical hyphenated text form; required.
claims.sid: Session UUID in canonical hyphenated text form; required by Atom deserialization and online session validation.
claims.tid: Tenant UUID in canonical hyphenated text form, or JSON null for a platform entity. Issued tokens always carry the key; verification also accepts an omitted key as None through serde Option semantics.
claims.iat: Integer Unix timestamp in seconds; required by Atom deserialization.
claims.exp: Integer Unix timestamp in seconds; required and validated; issued as iat + configured expiry seconds.

onlineChecksAfterSignature: session id exists and is not revoked or expired
subject entity exists, is active, and is not soft-deleted
owning tenant, when present, is active and not soft-deleted
compatibilityRule: Do not rename, remove, repurpose, or change the nullability/type of an issued header or claim in v1. Optional new claims may be added only after consumer compatibility review; authorization permissions remain database-authoritative and must not be embedded.
